summary: Largo Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K with a press release detailing a strategic production shift and debt restructuring. The company executed definitive restructuring agreements with Banco do Brasil, its largest creditor, covering roughly 48% of its US$82 million commercial bank senior debt, following an earlier agreement with Caixa Econômica Federal. Largo is pivoting toward higher-margin products, including high-purity vanadium and copper-PGM concentrates that generate about US$4.7 million in revenue with over 90% operating margins. The company is evaluating doubling copper-PGM output in 2027. Watch creditor participation progress and DLA supply execution as key risk-arb drivers.
